html:
The Gunya, or Kunja, are an Aboriginal Australian people of southwest Queensland, along the Warrego River around today's Cunnamulla.

Linguists treat their speech as close kin to that of the Margany to the west. Other neighbours were the Budjari, Gunu, Muruwari and Kooma. Sheep runs reached the Warrego in the 1860s, and Cunnamulla grew as a stock route town.
sum: The Gunya, or Kunja, are an Aboriginal Australian people of southwest Queensland, along the Warrego River around today's Cunnamulla.
